## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `--exclude` flag needs to read its default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`, because the project's CLI-flag rule requires every new flag to do this. Without it, CI cannot set exclusions through the environment.

## Changes
The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` option to `cli/main.py`. `collect` now skips files whose basename matches any of the patterns. It also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md`, adds five tests, and adds an unreferenced text fixture.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the --exclude default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — If you run the tool with `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE='*.log'` set and no `--exclude` flag, it still archives `.log` files, because line 17 hard-codes `default=[]`. `.claude/skills/cli-flags/reference.md:5` requires: "Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable". — CI jobs that set options through the environment cannot exclude files, which breaks a documented project rule for new flags. — Fix: Choose a separator for several globs in one variable, such as `os.pathsep`. Also decide whether CLI values add to the environment default or replace it, because `action="append"` adds to the default list. Then extend `test_exclude_defaults_to_nothing`.
